start.dialog: The Sea Witch needs ingredients for her greatest potion—the Breath of Oceans! It grants permanent underwater breathing! But the ingredients are rare: Moon Jelly essence, Deepwater Lotus, and Kraken blood. Gather them, and she'll share the potion!
start.objective: Collect Moon Jelly essence, Deepwater Lotus, and Kraken blood

progress.dialog: Two ingredients down! Just the Kraken blood left—but she needs it fresh! There's a young kraken near the Serpent's Spine. Collect a vial of its blood without killing it! A wounded kraken is dangerous!
progress.objective: Collect fresh Kraken blood from the Serpent's Spine

complete.dialog: The Breath of Oceans is complete! The Sea Witch keeps her word—one dose for you! From this day, you can breathe underwater as easily as air! Plus, here's a Sea Witch Charm for your trouble!

party_comments.kade: Permanent underwater breathing? I'll never drown again!
party_comments.twist: The Kraken was... unhappy about the blood donation.
party_comments.nix7: Alchemical aquatic adaptation: permanent. Respiratory efficiency: enhanced.
